description: Remove the company tracking domain. New emails use the shared Sequenzy tracking domain, and links and images in emails already sent through the removed domain stop working. Confirm with the user first.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: remove_tracking_domain

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `remove_tracking_domain` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

removed.description: True when a tracking domain was removed; false when none was set.

trackingDomain.description: Always null: links now use the shared Sequenzy tracking domain.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
